outlook.statement: The company initiated raising new capital through preferential allotment of equity shares to promoter and non-promoter category with the objective of developing its investment and wealth advisory and consultancy business. The company chose to enter into the wealth advisory after careful consideration of the synergies with the promoter group, which is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) having business operations in the same segment, and growing need for advisory services in India. The company is positive that this new direction will lead the company to grow its shareholder's value over the coming year, however, this is only the first step in the long way ahead.

The company's promoter undertook to meet all the liabilities of the company and have assured us that they will do so in the future, till such time that the company is self reliable. The company also undertook steps in becoming self reliable, with the first step being capital raising, which was initiated through a proposed preferential issue during the year.
